senses.example: Necesitas un abrigo para el invierno.
senses.exampleGloss: You need a coat for the winter.

alternatives.reason: Peninsular word for a longer, heavier jacket; warmer than a chaqueta, lighter than an abrigo.
Rainproof coat; a type of abrigo but a distinct word.
Short casual jacket, typically not warm enough for a Navarre winter.
